content_zh:
FS011两败俱伤
文森轻轻按住阿莱格拉的肩膀，看着她的眼睛，坚定道：“阿莱格拉，
“法师先生，我会等你的！”阿莱格拉也坚定的点头。
文森温柔的笑了笑，“我现在就去创造一个让你父亲拖延的条件！”
“阿莱格拉，我没在的时候，记得保护好自己！”文森拉起阿莱格拉白皙的小手，从自己手上褪下了那枚平淡无奇的契约之光。
这枚契约之光，正连接着疾风贪狼的主从契约。
“阿莱格拉，好好保管这枚指环，任何人让你取下来，都不要听！这枚指环叫契约之光，约束着疾风贪狼。以后，它就跟着你了。让它在这三年中代替我，好好地保护你！”文森将指环套在了阿莱格拉左手无名指上，随后在阿莱格拉光洁的额头轻轻一吻。
“再见，阿莱格拉！”文森头也不回，大步朝神话级强者破空坐标赶去。
阿莱格拉眼圈通红，抚摸着契约之光，喃喃道：“再见，法师先生！如果，三年后，你没有如约来带我走，那么”
安赫瑞尔要塞城主府演武广场上，德克兰一脸兴奋的站在场边。
“哈哈哈，老祖宗来了！这下我要让那该死的文森下地狱去吧！”德克兰手舞足蹈道。
他身边四个大战师同样眉开眼笑，这段时间这四个倒霉蛋被疾风贪狼欺负得够呛，连带着对文森的怨念也相当深刻。
“哟，德克兰兄弟，你来演武场干嘛？”大门口，文森吊儿郎当的调笑道，“难道我们之间要来一场决斗么？”
德克兰放肆的大笑道：“就凭你？还不够资格！”
“可怜的家伙，你知道我德克兰是谁吗？”德克兰骄傲的昂着头，如同一只孔雀，“我，德克兰，亚德瑞帝国子爵，帝都最年轻的高级魔法师，欧米茄公爵世家第二顺位继承人，光明教廷见习教士。”
“而且，你不知道的是，我们欧米茄家族有一位神话级的老祖宗坐镇！”德克兰戏谑的看着文森，不怀好意道：“重要的是，这位老祖宗即将到来！怎么样？这就是我给你的惊喜！”
“哦？是吗？我很惊讶！怎么样，你满意了没有？”文森皮笑肉不笑道。
德克兰毫不在意，用一种看死人的目光看向文森，“希望等会你还能如此牙尖嘴利！”
演武场正中心，虚空之中，一道道细如发丝的黑色裂纹时隐时现。平静的虚空如同破碎的镜面一般。
站在文森身后的克索斯脸色有些发白，“文森少爷，这是神话级的人物！”

文森仿佛没听见，抚摸着手指上的无尽之空。
无尽之空中的神话级卷轴只有三个！
并且都是初位神话等级！
如果欧米茄家族坐镇的神话级人物是中位神话级，那他只有动用最后的底牌了；如果是上位神话级，那么他自己抹脖子会舒服一些！
克索斯额头冒着冷汗，神色变幻不定，抓着法杖的手指泛白。他心中正在进行挣扎，文森的敌人显然有神话级人物，这个时候跟着文森，说不定下一刻就身死。
他心中冒出一个置身事外的想法来，反正他和文森也没有签订任何契约！
可是，克索斯却又想起了以前失去魔力时的辛酸，心中顿时有了决定。
“文森少爷，你快走，我来挡住他片刻！”克索斯突然站到了文森前面，头也不回道。
文森无声笑了起来，克索斯如此的表现，表明他已经真心效忠。文森十分满意克索斯如此，克索斯以后可是神话级的人物，签订契约都约束不住的。只有他自己真心自愿，否则休想他轻易臣服！
“克索斯管家，退下吧！你又能挡得住他几下？”文森笑眯眯的从无尽之空中取出三个卷轴。
卷轴刚刚拿出来之后，三道惊天动地的气息从卷轴中传出，这三道气息，和那空间裂缝中传出的气息几乎是相差无几！
“神话级卷轴！？”克索斯嘴巴张的圆圆的，显然无法接受这个事实。
卷轴的制作可不容易，想要制成神话级卷轴，即使是初位的，那么至少也要有神话级中位的实力，并且还要拥有那些罕见的材料！
“是啊！”文森思索了片刻，随即道：“家中长辈不放心，临出门前丢了三个神话级卷轴来。就是为了防备圣灵级和神话级人物的。”
文森继续扯着虎皮，将莫须有的家族逐渐构建的丰满。
能够拿出三个神话级卷轴的家族，显然绝对不是一般的家族了！
即使是神话级人物，也得掂量掂量面对另一个神话级人物的报复！
“德克兰小东西，你又在外面惹祸了！”演武场正中心，一股澎湃的气息升起，虚空的裂缝化作黑洞，一道模糊的人影从黑洞深处缓缓走出。
看见那人影，文森心中松了一口气，这人还只是初位神话级，否则在时空裂缝中走得不会这么慢！
想到这里，文森眼中凶恶之色一闪，反正他和德克兰已经势同水火，这个神话级人物又是对方的老祖宗，想来也会偏袒德克兰。

与其等待对方的出招，不如先下手为强！
文森拿出一个八级卷轴大地守护，圣灵级魔法大地守护土黄色的光盾将文森全身包裹，文森走向空间隧道口，展开了一个神话级卷轴！
神话级魔法——灭世黑炎！
卷轴开始化作光点，漆黑的空间隧道中心，一颗更加漆黑的黑炎开始汇聚。
纯粹的毁灭气息开始弥漫，安赫瑞尔要塞内的魔宠、普通动物，安赫瑞尔山脉边缘的魔兽统统都匍匐在地，眼中充满了惊恐！
阿莱格拉身旁的疾风贪狼突然呜呜呜的惊叫，惊慌的匍匐在阿莱格莱身前。
灭世黑炎，纯粹毁灭，只有毁灭！
文森笑嘻嘻的看着空间隧道中的那个神话级老者，“我知道灭世黑炎杀不了你，不过你也会费一番手脚吧！说不定恰好遇上空间风暴，把你弄得重伤呢！”
“畜生，你敢！”空间隧道中，那个神话级老者惊怒交加道。
老者名叫西撒－欧米茄，成为神话级强者不到十年，还属于初位中的初位！
灭世黑炎终于从卷轴中获得了完全的能量，成长为一颗直径超过了两米的巨大墨黑色光球。
墨黑色光球从中间裂开，一只漆黑的凤凰冲了出来，直扑向空间隧道中那个神话级老者！
“哼！”神话老者西撒－欧米茄怒哼，手中的法杖爆发出剧烈的蓝色光芒，洪亮的潮水声从空间隧道中传出，仿佛空间隧道的另一头是刚德泮溪大瀑布底一般。
“无穷无尽咆哮！”
文森额头一阵冷汗，神话级强者就是神话级强者，完全不能按照常理计算！
这么短的时间内，西撒－欧米茄居然已经释放出一个神话级魔法，九级水系次禁咒无穷无尽咆哮！
灭世黑炎幻化的黑炎凤凰无所畏惧的冲向滔天巨浪，黑炎经过的空间隧道寸寸碎裂！
文森脸色一喜，再次解开一张神话级卷轴，大吼道：“老不死的东西，看你还不死！”
“次级禁咒，虚空爆破！”
九级空间系次禁咒！

虚空爆破在空间隧道中的威力得到极大地加强，并且引起了大范围的虚空震荡，有向空间风暴演化的趋势。
“老鬼，去死吧！”文森嘿嘿大笑，空间隧道虽然好用，不过初位神话级的实力在空间隧道中可不够看！
空间风暴足以将初位神话强者弄得灰头土脸一身重伤！
“咔~~咔~~~咔~~~咔~~~”
一阵玻璃碎裂的声音响起，随后又如同玻璃落地的破裂声，然后传来一阵阵凄厉的痛嚎。
文森脸上泛起了胜利的微笑，不过下一刻，一道深蓝色的光线冲破了空间风暴，从文森身边擦过。
“啊！”文森一声惨叫，喷出一口鲜血，面色苍白。
他跌坐在地上，恨恨的看着逐渐合并的空间隧道，咬牙切齿道：“好你个老东西，今日之仇，他日必报！”
“文森少爷，您没事吧？”克索斯小心翼翼的扶起文森，关切的问道。
“暂时死不了！”文森转头看向已经傻了的德克兰，抬了抬手，最终放下。
“文森少爷，不把这个小畜生杀了？”克索斯低声问道。
文森冷哼一声，“暂时还不行，那个神话级老者虽然受伤了，不过并不是没有再战的实力，如果杀了这个小畜生，保不准那个老东西会再次来拼命！”
“那我们现在怎么办？”
“去荒野平原，在那里发展势力，三年后我要那个老东西好看！”文森再次狠狠的瞪了一眼德克兰，由克索斯扶着缓缓离开安赫瑞尔要塞城主府。
——————————————————————————————————————————
PS：才到家。
content_en:
FS011 Lose-lose situation
Vincent gently pressed Allegra's shoulders, looked into her eyes, and said firmly: "Alegra,
"Mr. Master, I will wait for you! "Allegra also nodded firmly.
Vincent smiled softly, "I will create a condition for your father to delay now! "
"Allegra, remember to protect yourself when I'm not around! "Vinson took Allegra's white little hand and took off the ordinary light of contract from his hand.
This light of contract is connecting the master-slave contract of Gale Greedy Wolf.
"Allegra, keep this ring carefully, and don't listen to anyone who asks you to take it off! This ring is called the Light of Contract, and it binds Gale Greedy Wolf. From now on, it will follow you. Let it replace me in these three years and protect you well! Vincent put the ring on Allegra's left ring finger, and then kissed Allegra's smooth forehead gently.
"Goodbye, Allegra! "Vinsen didn't even look back, and strode towards the coordinates of the mythical powerhouse Breaking the Sky.
Allegra's eyes were red, she touched the light of the contract and murmured: "Goodbye, Mr. Mage! If, after three years, you fail to take me away as promised, then"
In the Martial Arts Plaza of Angel Fortress City Lord's Mansion, Declan stood on the sidelines with an excited look on his face.
"Hahaha, the ancestor is here! Now I want that damn Vincent to go to hell! "Declan danced.
The four battle masters around him were also beaming. During this period, these four unlucky guys were bullied so much by Gale Greedy Wolf, and they even had a deep resentment towards Vincent.
"Hey, brother Declan, why are you here at the martial arts show? "At the gate, Vincent teased nonchalantly, "Are we going to have a duel? "
Declan laughed wildly and said, "Just you? Not qualified enough! "
“Poor guy, do you know who I am, Declan? Declan raised his head proudly, like a peacock, "I, Declan, Viscount of the Adre Empire, the youngest senior magician in the imperial capital, the second heir to the Omega Duke family, and a trainee priest of the Holy See of Light." "
“Furthermore, what you don’t know is that our Omega family has a mythical ancestor sitting in charge! Declan looked at Vincent jokingly and said maliciously: "The important thing is that this ancestor is coming soon!" How about it? This is my surprise for you! "
"oh? Yeah? I was surprised! How is it, are you satisfied? Vincentpi said with a smile.
Declan didn't care and looked at Vincent with a dead look, "I hope you can still be so sharp-tongued later! "
In the center of the martial arts arena, in the void, black cracks as thin as hair appear and disappear. The calm void is like a broken mirror.
Kesos, who was standing behind Vincent, turned pale, "Master Vincent, this is a mythical figure! "
Vincent seemed not to hear, stroking the endless space on his fingers.
There are only three mythical scrolls in the endless sky!
And they are all at the first-level myth level!
If the mythical character sitting in the Omega family is at the mid-level mythical level, then he can only use his last trump card; if he is at the upper mythical level, then he will feel more comfortable wiping his neck himself!
Cold sweat broke out on Xos's forehead, his expression changed, and the fingers holding the staff turned white. He was struggling in his heart. Vincent's enemies obviously had mythical figures. If he followed Vincent at this time, he might die in the next moment.
An idea came to his mind to stay out of the matter. Anyway, he and Vincent did not sign any contract!
However, Xosos remembered the bitterness of losing his magic power in the past, and he suddenly made a decision in his heart.
"Master Vincent, go away quickly, I'll stop him for a moment! "Xosus suddenly stood in front of Vincent and said without looking back.
Vincent laughed silently. Xosos's performance showed that he was sincerely loyal.Vincent is very satisfied with Kesos's behavior. In the future, Kesos will be a mythical figure who cannot be restrained by signing a contract. Only if he is truly willing, otherwise he can't surrender easily!
"Butler Xos, step back! How many times can you stop him?" Vincent took out three scrolls from the endless sky with a smile.
Just after the scroll was taken out, three earth-shaking breaths came out of the scroll. These three breaths were almost the same as the breath coming out of the space crack!
"Mythical scroll!?" Xosos's mouth opened wide, obviously unable to accept this fact.
Making a scroll is not easy. If you want to make a mythical scroll, even if you are in the first level, you must at least have the strength of the middle level mythical level, and you must also have those rare materials!
"Yes!" Vincent thought for a moment and then said: "The elders in the family were worried and threw three mythical scrolls before leaving. It was just to guard against Holy Spirit and Mythical characters."
Vincent continued to pull the tiger's skin, gradually building up the imaginary family.
A family that can produce three mythical scrolls is obviously not an ordinary family!
Even a mythical figure has to weigh the revenge of another mythical figure!
"Little Declan, you caused trouble outside again!" In the center of the martial arts arena, a surging aura rose, the crack in the void turned into a black hole, and a blurry figure slowly walked out from the depths of the black hole.
Seeing the figure, Vincent breathed a sigh of relief. This person was only at the first level of myth, otherwise he wouldn't be walking so slowly in the cracks in time and space!
Thinking of this, Vincent's eyes flashed with evil. Anyway, he and Declan were already on the same level. This mythical figure was the ancestor of the other party, so he would probably favor Declan.
Instead of waiting for the opponent to make a move, it is better to strike first!
Vincent took out an eighth-level scroll, Earth Guardian, and the Holy Spirit-level magic Earth Guardian's khaki light shield enveloped Vincent's body. Vincent walked toward the entrance of the space tunnel and unfolded a mythical scroll!
Mythical magic - the world-destroying black flame!
The scroll began to turn into points of light, and in the center of the dark space tunnel, an even darker black flame began to gather.
The pure aura of destruction began to permeate the air. The familiars, ordinary animals in Angelil Fortress, and the magical beasts on the edge of Angelil Mountains all prostrated on the ground, their eyes filled with fear!
The Gale Greedy Wolf next to Allegra suddenly screamed and crawled in front of Allegra in panic.
World-destroying black flames, pure destruction, only destruction!
Vincent looked at the mythical old man in the space tunnel with a smile, "I know the world-destroying black flame can't kill you, but you will have to try your best! Maybe there will be a space storm and you will be seriously injured!"
"Beast, how dare you!" In the space tunnel, the mythical old man shouted in shock and anger.
The old man's name is Caesar Omega. He has been a mythical powerhouse for less than ten years, and he is still the first among the first!
The Black Flame of Destruction finally obtained full energy from the scroll and grew into a huge black ball of light with a diameter of more than two meters.
The jet-black ball of light split from the middle, and a pitch-black phoenix rushed out and rushed towards the mythical old man in the space tunnel!
"Huh!" The mythical old man Caesar Omega roared angrily. The staff in his hand erupted with a violent blue light, and the loud sound of the tide came from the space tunnel, as if the other end of the space tunnel was at the bottom of the Gangdepan River Falls.
"Endless roar!"
Vincent broke into a cold sweat on his forehead. A mythical powerhouse is a mythical powerhouse. It cannot be calculated according to common sense!
In such a short period of time, Caesar-Omega has actually released a mythical magic, a ninth-level water-type sub-forbidden curse that roars endlessly!
The black flame phoenix transformed by the world-destroying black flame fearlessly rushed towards the huge waves. The space tunnel that the black flame passed through was shattered inch by inch!
Vincent's face lit up, and thenUnlocking a mythical scroll for the first time, he shouted: "You immortal thing, let's see if you are still alive!"
"Secondary Forbidden Spell, Void Explosion!"
The ninth-level space-based forbidden spell!
The power of void blasting in the space tunnel has been greatly enhanced, and it has caused large-scale void oscillations, tending to evolve into space storms.
"Old ghost, go to hell!" Vincent laughed. Although the space tunnel is easy to use, the first-level mythical strength is not enough to be seen in the space tunnel!
The space storm was enough to make the first mythical strong man disgraced and seriously injured!
"Ka~~ka~~~ka~~~ka~~~"
There was a sound of shattering glass, and then there was a sound like glass falling to the ground, and then there were bursts of shrill howls of pain.
A smile of victory appeared on Vincent's face, but the next moment, a dark blue light broke through the space storm and passed by Vincent.
"Ah!" Vincent screamed, spitting out a mouthful of blood, his face turned pale.
He fell to the ground, looked at the gradually merging space tunnels with hatred, gritted his teeth and said: "You old man, today's revenge will be avenged tomorrow!"
"Master Vincent, are you okay?" Xosos carefully helped Vincent up and asked with concern.
"You can't die for now!" Vincent turned to look at Declan who was already stunned, raised his hand, and finally put it down.
"Master Vincent, won't you kill this little beast?" Xos asked in a low voice.
Vincent snorted coldly, "Not yet. Although the mythical old man was injured, he is not without the strength to fight again. If we kill this little beast, there is no guarantee that the old man will fight again!"
"Then what do we do now?"
"Go to the wilderness plains and develop your power there. In three years, I want that old guy to look good!" Vincent glared at Declan again and slowly left the main palace of Angelil Fortress with the support of Xosos.
